integrity: Analytic derivation plus fully reconstructible finite numerical checks. Bibliographic priority limited to inspected sources. Not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetical quadrature weights with isotropic Gaussian measure, Gaussian kernel, axis-orbit design and zero nugget only; no global accuracy optimality or floating-point safety. General fully symmetric orbit reduction and negative center phenomenon were already published in 2018. Novel claim limited to sharp radius, uniqueness and high-dimensional scaling.
title: A sharp positivity radius for Gaussian sigma-point kernel quadrature
